files_summary.iris.csv: Pipe‑delimited CSV file ("|" as separator) containing the classic Iris dataset. Header: sepal_length|sepal_width|petal_length|petal_width|species. 150 records covering three species (setosa, versicolor, virginica) with numeric measurements.
files_summary.sales.csv: Pipe‑delimited CSV file ("|" as separator) with sample sales transaction data. Header: id|product_name|category|price|quantity|sale_date|customer_name|customer_age|customer_city|sales_rep|commission_rate. 40 rows of mixed Chinese and English values representing product sales, customer info, and sales‑rep commissions.
files_summary.countries.json: JSON array of country objects. Each object has fields: name (country name), flag (emoji), code (ISO‑3166‑1 alpha‑2), dial_code (international telephone prefix). Includes entries for many world nations (approx. 200+ records).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: load_iris
tool_schemas.description: Loads the Iris demo dataset and returns the full set of measurements as a list of records. This endpoint refuses requests if the Iris dataset is unavailable or cannot be read or parsed into records. It also refuses if the dataset contains invalid or missing required fields that prevent building consistent records.

tool_schemas.name: iris_summary
tool_schemas.description: Computes and returns basic summary statistics (count, mean, min, max) for each numeric column in the Iris dataset. This endpoint refuses requests if the Iris dataset cannot be loaded, or if the numeric columns needed for summary are missing or contain non-numeric values that cannot be summarized. It also refuses if the dataset is empty, because summary statistics cannot be computed meaningfully.

tool_schemas.name: load_sales
tool_schemas.description: Loads the sales transactions demo dataset and returns the full set of transactions as a list of records. This endpoint refuses requests if the sales dataset is unavailable or cannot be read or parsed into records. It also refuses if required transaction fields are missing or invalid in a way that prevents constructing consistent transaction records.

tool_schemas.name: filter_sales_by_city
tool_schemas.description: Returns all sales transaction records whose customer city matches the provided city value. This endpoint refuses requests that omit the city parameter, provide an empty city, or provide a non-string city value. It also refuses if the sales dataset cannot be loaded or if transaction records do not include a city field to match against.

city.description: Name of the city to filter sales by.

tool_schemas.name: aggregate_sales_by_product
tool_schemas.description: Aggregates sales by product and returns totals where revenue is computed as price multiplied by quantity per transaction and summed per product. This endpoint refuses requests if the sales dataset cannot be loaded, if required fields (product, price, quantity) are missing, or if price/quantity values are not numeric and cannot be used to compute revenue. It also refuses if there are no valid transactions to aggregate.

tool_schemas.name: load_countries
tool_schemas.description: Loads the countries demo dataset and returns the full list of country objects. This endpoint refuses requests if the countries dataset is unavailable or cannot be read or parsed into country objects. It also refuses if the dataset is not a list of country objects or contains invalid entries that prevent returning a consistent list.

tool_schemas.name: get_country_by_code
tool_schemas.description: Looks up and returns the country object whose ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code matches the provided code. This endpoint refuses requests that omit the code parameter, provide an empty or non-string code, or provide a code that is not a two-letter ISO alpha-2 value. It also refuses if the countries dataset cannot be loaded or if no country exists with the requested code.

tool_schemas.name: list_country_names
tool_schemas.description: Returns a list of country names for every country in the countries dataset. This endpoint refuses requests if the countries dataset cannot be loaded or if country objects do not include a name field that can be listed. It also refuses if the dataset is empty or contains no valid country names to return.

tool_schemas.name: find_country_by_dial_code
tool_schemas.description: Finds and returns all country objects whose telephone dial code matches the provided dial_code. This endpoint refuses requests that omit dial_code, provide an empty or non-string value, or provide a value that is not in dial-code form (including the leading '+'). It also refuses if the countries dataset cannot be loaded or if country entries do not include dial-code information to match against.

dial_code.description: Telephone dial code to match, including the leading '+' (e.g., '+1').

metadata.name: AtlasSeed Data Hub
metadata.description: A lightweight backend service that loads common starter datasets and provides simple lookup, filtering, and summary APIs for countries, iris measurements, and sales transactions.
